page_title: FIO 2-1 LAZ | Fiorentina v Lazio 26/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A shot from the edge of the box by Matias Vecino (Lazio) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
90+4' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
90+3' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Andrea Belotti walks off the pitch and M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
90' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) replaces Arthur Melo.
88' What was Matias Vecino (Lazio) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
87' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
85' Substitution. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) on for Riccardo Sottil.
81' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
81' The substitution has been made. Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) has replaced Lucas Beltran.
78' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Felipe Anderson will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
78' Ciro Immobile will be replaced by Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
77' Corner kicks – 12:2.
73' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
72' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
69' 2 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:1.
69' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Ivan Provedel.
67' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
67' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
67' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
67' Referee Marco Guida is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Fiorentina!
67' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Fiorentina as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
66' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Fiorentina!
64' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matias Vecino (Lazio) comes onto the pitch so that Danilo Cataldi can be given a rest.
61' 1 - 1 What a finish by Michael Kayode (Fiorentina)! He latches on to a cross inside the penalty area and takes a shot which goes in off the inside of the right post.

60' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
60' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) will deliver the corner kick.
56' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
56' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
55' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
53' The total number of attempts is 13:3.
48' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
46' Maurizio Sarri makes a half-time substitution. Elseid Hysaj comes on in place of Adam Marusic (Lazio).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is replaced by Mattia Zaccagni.
46' Referee Marco Guida blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 0 - 1 Goal! Matteo Guendouzi tees up Luis Alberto (Lazio) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 0:1.
44' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nicolo Casale (Lazio).
41' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) whips in the corner and tries to score, but the ball hits the bar.
41' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
40' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

39' It looks like Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) saw red with that tackle. Marco Guida won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Fiorentina are awarded the free kick. Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. Fiorentina get a corner.
38' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) commits a rough foul. Marco Guida stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
34' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
34' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) takes it short.
32' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Guida blows for a foul.
27' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) tries to find Riccardo Sottil, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
24' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
24' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
24' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) sees his header crash off the left post after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
24' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) takes the corner.
20' A corner kick by Fiorentina is thwarted by the well prepared Ivan Provedel (Lazio).
19' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.
19' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) squanders a great opportunity after striking the ball onto the post!
18' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
17' Luis Alberto (Lazio) prepares to take a corner kick.
16' An attempted cross from Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' Ivan Provedel (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
13' The game is interrupted now, Ivan Provedel (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
10' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
10' The corner by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
10' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' A pass from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel and the move breaks down.
7' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

7' Luis Alberto (Lazio) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
6' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
3' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) sends the corner into the box, but Ivan Provedel intercepts it and averts the threat.

2' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but it's cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

2' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net. Corner kick. Fiorentina will have an opportunity.
2' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
1' The first half has started.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
Marco Guida got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
